key_sentences: I ought to be thy Adam; but I am rather the fallen angel, whom thou drivest from joy for no misdeed.

en-1818: Remember, that I am thy creature: I ought to be thy Adam; but I am rather the fallen angel, whom thou drivest from joy for no misdeed. Every where I see bliss, from which I alone am irrevocably excluded. I was benevolent and good; misery made me a fiend. Make me happy, and I shall again be virtuous.
